gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred during the year, net of reinsurance, included positive prior year development of GBP 3.3m (2021: GBP 39.7m) on the net claims reserves that existed at the end of the prior financial year.
gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1110 reported a positive prior year development of GBP 3.3 million in 2022, indicating a strengthening of net claims reserves. This development relates to reserves that existed at the end of the prior financial year (31 December 2021), affecting underwriting years from 2013 to 2020. The report attributes the increase in net claims incurred generally to the impact of claims inflation and deterioration of casualty business, which likely contributed to this prior year strengthening.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 221.885m. During 2022 there was a modest favourable prior year development on net reserves of GBP 3.3m (a release), representing approximately a 1.5% reduction relative to opening gross reserves. The report attributes reserve movements elsewhere in the year to transactions such as the Syndicate 5678 RITC and the Hiscox ADC and notes claims inflation and deterioration in casualty business, but the explicitly quantified prior-year movement cited in the accounts is a small favourable development on prior reserves.
